title: Fix firstmate study claims until the source check passes
summary: Add t5 to the places-held counter's changed_by in the firstmate study model with a citation to bin/fm-backlog-transition-lib.sh:845-851, then rerun the source check and correct each further reported claim until it reports none.

defaults_applied.how: Criterion requires the source check to pass with no findings.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Goal: the maintainer wants the firstmate study page to pass its source check; the audience is the verifier running that check.
Only study data under studies/firstmate-work-handling changes; pin.json stays unchanged.
The exact check command is found in xtask/ or docs; the producer runs it repeatedly since it reports one wrong claim per run.
Not read in detail: claims.json contents; the file list is a guess weighted to model.json and claims.json.

acceptance_criteria.text: studies/firstmate-work-handling/model.json places-held counter changed_by includes t5, with a claim citing bin/fm-backlog-transition-lib.sh lines 845-851 (task record removed before backlog close).
Run the study source check (cargo run -p xtask with the repo's study-check subcommand) on firstmate-work-handling; it reports no findings.

Every further claim the check reports is corrected with a citation to the pinned source, not deleted or weakened to pass; claims.json, rationales.json and findings.json stay consistent with model.json.
cargo test and cargo clippy pass with the study files changed.

out_of_scope: Changing the source check itself or loosening its rules
departures: Iterative loop: one wrong claim per run raises cost and time over reference.
